title: Sparkly alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles around the clock -->
  <g fill="#FFE96B">
    <path d="M18 24 L20 18 L22 24 L28 26 L22 28 L20 34 L18 28 L12 26 Z"/>
    <path d="M80 16 L82 10 L84 16 L90 18 L84 20 L82 26 L80 20 L74 18 Z"/>
    <path d="M14 66 L16 60 L18 66 L24 68 L18 70 L16 76 L14 70 L8 68 Z"/>
    <path d="M84 70 L86 64 L88 70 L94 72 L88 74 L86 80 L84 74 L78 72 Z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle centers -->
  <g fill="#FFF7C2">
    <circle cx="20" cy="26" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="18" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="16" cy="68" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="86" cy="72" r="2.2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bell left -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="30" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#FFB13B" stroke="#FFD36B" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- bell right -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="30" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#FFB13B" stroke="#FFD36B" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- bell tops -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="26" r="4" fill="#FFE29A"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="26" r="4" fill="#FFE29A"/>

  <!-- top handle -->
  <rect x="44" y="34" width="12" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFD36B"/>

  <!-- clock body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="28" fill="#FF5C5C" stroke="#FF9B9B" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- inner face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="21" fill="#FFF4D6" stroke="#FFD9A0" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- clock hands -->
  <line x1="50" y1="58" x2="50" y2="43" stroke="#4B5BD7" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="58" x2="62" y2="64" stroke="#4B5BD7" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="3" fill="#6E7BFF"/>

  <!-- hour dots -->
  <g fill="#FF9B6B">
    <circle cx="50" cy="39" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="67" cy="48" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="67" cy="68" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="77" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="33" cy="68" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="33" cy="48" r="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- little legs -->
  <rect x="34" y="84" width="7" height="8" rx="3" fill="#FF8A3D"/>
  <rect x="59" y="84" width="7" height="8" rx="3" fill="#FF8A3D"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x="31" y="90" width="13" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#FFC56B"/>
  <rect x="56" y="90" width="13" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#FFC56B"/>
</svg>
